column13: Set the search term and the result count, then call _satellite.track('internal_search'). Send the term exactly as the customer typed it, in lower case, with leading and trailing spaces removed and nothing else changed. Send the result count as a number. Zero is a real result count and must be sent as zero, because that is what makes a null search visible.

column4: A home page banner is clicked
column13: Set the banner name and its position, then call _satellite.track('banner_click'). Position is the slot on the page, counted from the top, and it is set by the page rather than by the campaign. The same banner in a different slot must report a different position.

column13: One rule covers the header, the main menu and the footer. Set the navigation level so the three can be told apart in reporting, and set the item to the full path the customer clicked, joined with a colon.

column4: A form is started, and a form is submitted. One solution covers every form on the site.
column13: Two calls, one solution. Set the form name, then call _satellite.track('form_start') when the customer first types into any field, and _satellite.track('form_submit') when the submission is accepted. Fire the start once per form per page view, not once per field. Use the same form name in both calls, or the two numbers cannot be compared.

column7: Trade Account Application, Contact Us, Newsletter Signup

column4: An error is shown to the customer
column13: Set the error type and the detail, then call _satellite.track('error'). The detail is the message the customer sees. A page not found must also carry the URL that was not found, because the error is useless without it.

column7: Page Not Found, Payment Gateway, Form Validation, Server Error
The message shown, or the URL that was not found
